row.question_sw: Mwajiri anaweza kuomba msamaha wa SDL vipi?
row.answer_sw: Mwajiri anayetaka msamaha wa SDL lazima aandike ombi rasmi kwa Kamishna wa TRA akitoa sababu za kisheria za msamaha, kama vile hadhi ya EPZ, hali ya shirika lisilo la faida, au msamaha mwingine uliowekwa kisheria. Ombi linapaswa kuambatanishwa na: cheti cha usajili wa shirika, hati inayothibitisha hadhi ya msamaha (k.m. cheti cha EPZA au hati ya shirika lisilo la faida), na nyaraka za BRELA. TRA itapitia ombi na kutoa uamuzi kwa maandishi. Usidai msamaha kabla ya kupata uamuzi wa TRA.
row.answer_en: An employer seeking SDL exemption must write a formal application to the TRA Commissioner General stating the legal grounds for exemption, such as EPZ status, non-profit organisation status, or another statutory exemption. The application should be accompanied by: the organisation's registration certificate, documentation confirming exemption status (e.g., EPZA certificate or non-profit deed), and BRELA documents. TRA will review the application and issue a written decision. Do not claim exemption before receiving TRA's written decision.

row.question_sw: Faida za kufanya biashara ndani ya Eneo Maalum la Uchumi (Special Economic Zone — SEZ) Tanzania ni zipi?
row.answer_sw: Biashara zilizoidhinishwa kwenye SEZ Tanzania zinapata faida kadhaa: msamaha wa kodi ya mapato ya kampuni kwa miaka 10 ya kwanza, msamaha wa VAT na ushuru wa forodha kwenye bidhaa za uingizaji zinazotumiwa kwenye uzalishaji, msamaha wa SDL, na msamaha wa mrabaha wa ardhi. Baada ya miaka 10, kiwango cha kodi kinapungua. Usajili unafanywa kupitia Mamlaka ya Maeneo Maalum ya Uchumi Tanzania (EPZA/SEZA). Bidhaa zinazotengenezwa SEZ zinaweza kuuzwa nje ya nchi au ndani ya Tanzania (na ushuru wa forodha unaotumika kwa mauzo ya ndani).
row.answer_en: Businesses approved in a Tanzania SEZ receive several benefits: corporate income tax exemption for the first 10 years, VAT and customs duty exemption on imported inputs used in production, SDL exemption, and land rent exemption. After 10 years, a reduced tax rate applies. Registration is through the Tanzania Special Economic Zones Authority (EPZA/SEZA). Goods manufactured in an SEZ can be exported or sold domestically (with applicable customs duty on domestic sales).
row.question_en: What are the benefits of operating a business within a Special Economic Zone (SEZ) in Tanzania?

row.question_sw: Wakati TRA inakagua PAYE ya kampuni yangu, wanakagua nini hasa?
row.answer_sw: Wakati wa ukaguzi wa PAYE, TRA wanakagua: orodha ya mishahara (payroll) kwa miaka yote inayopitiwa, rekodi za benki za malipo ya mshahara, mikataba ya ajira ya wafanyakazi, return za PAYE zilizowasilishwa, fomu za P9 zilizotolewa kwa wafanyakazi, vielelezo vya michango ya ziada kama posho za nyumba na usafiri, na malipo yoyote yanayosemekana kuwa ya 'mkopo' au 'kama ada'. Tofauti kati ya rekodi za benki na payroll ni dalili kuu ya udanganyifu.
row.answer_en: During a PAYE audit, TRA examines: payroll records for all years under review, bank statements showing salary payments, employment contracts, submitted PAYE returns, P9 forms issued to employees, documentation for additional payments such as housing and transport allowances, and any payments classified as 'loans' or 'fees'. Discrepancies between bank records and the payroll are a key fraud indicator.
row.question_en: When TRA audits our company's PAYE, what exactly do they examine?
